Cycle Canalway Sunday Social Ride

Cleveland, OH · Flats · Social

Beginner friendly

Cycle Canalway Sunday Social Ride is a social group ride in Cleveland, OH. It rolls third Sunday of the month at 10:00 am from Canal Basin Park. About 8 miles, guided, easy.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive

Check
Look at @canalwaycle the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cycle Canalway Sunday Social Ride group ride

Free guided rides from Canal Basin Park along the Lake Link Trail to Edgewater Park and back. Ride support from the Ohio City Bicycle Co-op. Helmets required.
